editor.locked: The format and the field can't change once the tournament has started.
editor.checkin_help: With check-in, entrants confirm in the minutes before the start; the rest are left out.
editor.discussion_help: A discussion is started for the tournament when sign-ups open, in the tag chosen here. Match discussions start as each match is ready.
editor.predictions_help: Members pick the winner of every match before it starts and score as results come in — 10 points a round-one pick, doubling each round, unless you set other values. With Picks, link each match to its game and results arrive by themselves.
editor.rewards_help: Points need FoF Gamification with point grants; the badge needs FoF Badges. Paid to every member of a placed entrant (or, in a prediction bracket, to the best predictors).
